condition.narrative: The Recipient shall monitor and evaluate the progress of the Project and prepare Project Reports in accordance with the provisionsof Section 4.08 of the General Conditions and on the basis of indicators acceptable to the Association. Each Project Report shallcover the period of one (1) calendar quarter, and shall be furnished to the Association not later than forty-five (45) days afterthe end of the period covered by such report.

The Recipient shall, not later than four (4) months prior to the mid-term review referred to in paragraph 3 of this Section II.A,furnish to the Association for comments, a report, in such detail as the Association shall reasonably request, on the progress ofthe Project, and giving details of the various matters to be discussed at such review.

The Recipient shall, not later than thirty (30) months after the Effective Date, undertake, in conjunction with all agenciesinvolved in the Project, a comprehensive mid-term review of the Project during which it shall exchange views with the Associationand implementing agencies generally on all matters relating to the progress of the Project, the performance by the Recipient of itsobligations under this Agreement and the performance by said implementing agencies, having regard to the performance indicatorsreferred to in paragraph 1 of this Section II.A.

title.narrative: Percentage of the population covered by at least a 3G mobile network

comment.narrative: The indicator measured the number of people with increased access to affordable high quality internet services. Target overachieved based on MACRA data.

title.narrative: Retail Price of Pre-Paid Mobile Broadband Monthly Bundle, 500MB Data Volume

comment.narrative: Both the original target (US$3.00) and the updated target (US$2.00) are overachieved. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Average wholesale monthly price per Mbit/s of international internet bandwidth

comment.narrative: Wholesale prices for international bandwidth continue to fall, and a significant reduction was noted once the results of the Government connectivity transaction recorded. Original and updated targeted overachieved. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Number of Transactions Per Year Utilizing the Shared Digital Services Platform

comment.narrative: The shared digital services platform has been successfully launched, processing 1,645 transactions from the six e-services provided on the platform. The actual number achieved at completion reported here includes the UAT transactions. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: People obtaining new digital skills or knowledge under the project

comment.narrative: The project has been providing capacity building training for project stakeholders to support efficient implementation and sustainability. This training has expanded across MDAs and other key stakeholders. The project trained over 19,000 youth, far exceeding the original 1,500 target and the revised 5,000. Target overachieved. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Number of Public Institutions Utilizing High Speed Internet Connections Under the Project

comment.narrative: The project provided high-speed internet prepaid for 10 years to government offices and Government Local Area Network (GLAN) locations. Target overachieved. Data based on team's estimate informed by client's data.

Total beneficiaries calculated based upon number of internet users in Malawi. Project based upon an estimated target of 30% usage and a total population projection of 20.9 million in 2022. Beneficiaries of all other skills development, digital services, etc. activities are assumed to be captured within the internet users figure. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Number of MDAs and LGAs using eProcurement System

comment.narrative: The contract for the development of the e-Procurement system was signed just 12 months before project closure, leaving insufficient time for implementation. Thus, the e-Procurement system is not fully operationalized yet, not allowing to achieve the indicator target.

title.narrative: Publication and Adoption of National Strategies for Broadband Access and Digital Government

comment.narrative: Both the  Digital Government Strategy and the National Broadband Strategy have  been approved, adopted and signed by the office of the President.

title.narrative: Number of Higher Education Students Provided with Enhanced with Access to the Internet Under the Project

comment.narrative: Both the original target (10,000) and the updated target (50,000) have been overachieved. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Number of e-Services and Applications Utilizing the Shared Services Platform

comment.narrative: The project deployed a shared services platform, which includes a data center, enterprise service bus, mobile gateway and digital services portal. The indicator is defined as count of the systems, pre-existing or otherwise, that will connect to the shared platform. Target overachieved. Data from the client closing report.

title.narrative: Digital services developed based on priorities identified through citizen engagement (Yes/No)

comment.narrative: The public WiFi project fulfils requirements for a priority activity identified through citizen engagement, and in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Data from the client closing report.
